text:
Beat the drum without fear,
and embrace the canteen girl:
there is the whole science of it,
the truest meaning
of the finest book.

Let your drum’s noise
wake the sleeping world;
play reveille with ardor.
March on, ever upright!
That is sovereign wisdom.

Hegel’s profoundest,
most complete meaning—
I learned it, and it is proven:
I am a worldly lad,
and a skilled drummer.

translation.title: Beat the Drum Without Fear
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
